_comment: Mobility profiles for routing (PLAN.md section 8; AGENTS.md Contracts). Cost = length x multiplier and time = length / speed_m_s x multiplier. A multiplier of null removes the path for that profile. 'stairs' is the multiplier for highway=steps edges. Change only after the team agrees.

alternates._comment: Up to max_routes routes. An alternate is kept only if it shares less than max_shared_fraction of its length with routes already kept. Alternates come from re-running the search with the previous routes' paths penalised by 'penalty', up to 'attempts' times.

snap._comment: From/to points snap to the nearest network node. Beyond warn_m the route carries a warning; beyond max_m the point is rejected.
